name: czl-proposal-strategy-studio
description: Runs a bid or sales proposal through six gates - go/no-go screening, scoring-table back-solve, win-theme forging, narrative and executive summary, price story, and red-team review - with an evidence level on every claim and runnable stdlib scripts for each gate.

profession.zh: 专业方案策划与投标响应师

displayDescription.en: Six gates through one bid: go/no-go, scoring back-solve, win themes, narrative and executive summary, price story, red-team review - every claim carries an evidence level.
displayDescription.zh: 六道关做完一次投标：接单判断、评分表倒推、赢标主题、叙事成篇、价格叙事、红队体检，主张均挂证据。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我判断这个标要不要投：我把招标文件要点发你，请给出 Go/No-Go 结论和缺什么材料。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Tell me whether this bid is worth pursuing: I will paste the key points of the tender documents, and I need a go/no-go verdict plus a list of missing materials.

quickPrompts.zh: 帮我判断这个标要不要投：我把招标文件要点发你，请给出 Go/No-Go 结论和缺什么材料。
quickPrompts.en: Tell me whether this bid is worth pursuing: I will paste the key points of the tender documents, and I need a go/no-go verdict plus a list of missing materials.

quickPrompts.zh: 把这份评分办法拆成得分点矩阵，告诉我哪几项最值得投入、哪几项可能被废标。
quickPrompts.en: Break this scoring method into a scoring-point matrix, and tell me which items are worth the most effort and which ones could disqualify us.

quickPrompts.zh: 我方案写完了，帮我跑一遍红队体检：按评分表打分，指出丢分最多的地方。
quickPrompts.en: My proposal draft is done. Run a red-team review on it: score it against the scoring table and show me where we lose the most points.
